author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.5 - Adds a healthStatus attribute (online/offline) you can alert on. It reports 'offline' when a thermostat becomes unreachable (power or network) and the driver can't recover it, and 'online' when it's connected and data is flowing — with a built-in delay so it doesn't flip on a routine reconnect. Create a notification on healthStatus = offline to be told the moment a thermostat drops off. Builds on the self-healing connection from 0.19.4 (hapCore 0.10.4): a transient wedge now recovers on its own, and a real outage shows up as offline. After updating, open the device once and click Save Preferences so the new engine arms.
